"d"."CompanyCode","d"."MasterFixedAsset","d"."FixedAsset","d"."FixedAssetExternalID","d"."AssetClass","d"."AssetSerialNumber","d"."Quantity","d"."BaseUnit","d"."Inventory","d"."FixedAssetDescription","d"."AssetAdditionalDescription","d"."Currency","d"."OriglAcqnAmtInCoCodeCrcy","d"."PartnerCompany","d"."AssetManufacturerName","d"."InHouseProdnPercent","d"."AssetSupplierName","d"."InventoryNote","d"."Group1AssetEvaluationKey","d"."Group2AssetEvaluationKey","d"."Group3AssetEvaluationKey","d"."Group4AssetEvaluationKey","d"."Group5AssetEvaluationKey","d"."AssetAccountDetermination","d"."HasHistory","d"."AssetCapitalizationDate","d"."FirstAcquisitionFiscalYear","d"."FirstAcquisitionFiscalPeriod","d"."AssetDeactivationDate","d"."PlannedRetirementDate","d"."FixedAssetOrderDate","d"."OriginalMasterFixedAsset","d"."FixedAssetGroup","d"."InvestmentReason","d"."AssetIsRealEstate","d"."AreaSizeUnit","d"."InvestmentOrder","d"."InvestmentProjectWBSElement_2","d"."InvestmentProjectWBSElement","d"."InventoryIsCounted","d"."LastInventoryDate","d"."AssetSynchronizationRule","d"."OriginalAcquisitionFiscalYear","d"."AssetTypeName","d"."Supplier","d"."AssetCountryOfOrigin","d"."NoticeOfAssessmentTaxID","d"."LastAssessmentNoticeDate","d"."EnvrnmtlInvestmentReason","d"."LastChangeDate","d"."FixedAssetFinDataCmpltns","d"."AccountIsMarkedForDeletion","d"."AccountIsBlockedForPosting","d"."AcquisitionValueDate","d"."OriginalFixedAssetValueDate","d"."AssetUnderConstIsInvmtMsr","d"."LastRetirementValueDate","d"."LastChangedByUser","d"."FixedAssetPropertyType","d"."CreationDate","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."ManualDepreciationReason","d"."LastReorganizationDate","d"."LegacyDataTransferDate","d"."IsGroupAsset","d"."IsLineItemSettled","d"."OriginalFixedAsset","d"."MasterFixedAssetSearchTerm","d"."AssetStatusAtPurchase","d"."AssetIsAcquiredUsed","d"."IsMainAsset","d"."AssetLifecycleStatus","d"."AssetCompletenessStatus","d"."AssetUnderConstructionStatus","d"."AssetCreationValidityDate","d"."CreationDateTime","d"."LastChangeDateTime","d"."AssetScreenLayout","d"."OriginalAcquisitionAmount","d"."OriginalAcquisitionCurrency","d"."PropertyClass","d"."LocalTaxOffice","d"."Municipality","d"."LandRegisterDate","d"."LandRegisterEntrySequence","d"."LandRegisterEntryDate","d"."LandRegisterVolume","d"."LandRegisterPage","d"."LandRegisterMap","d"."LandPlot","d"."ConveyanceDate","d"."AreaSize","d"."LeaseSupplier","d"."LeaseAgreement","d"."LeaseAgreementDate","d"."LeaseTermEndDate","d"."LeaseTermStartDate","d"."LeaseDurationInFiscalYears","d"."LeaseDurationInFiscalPeriods","d"."LeaseType","d"."LeasedAssetNote","d"."LegacyAsset","d"."LegacyFixedAssetCompanyCode","d"."LegacyMasterFixedAsset","d"."LegacyFixedAsset","d"."LegacyDataTransferSequence","d"."AssetIsForPostCapitalization","d"."AssetAuthorizationContext","d"."ObjectInternalID","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date"
